Useful for those appearing in CSPT-2024

Introduction:
 started the channel @PTT2023 on telegram in his early days of CSE
Preparation. Since then, this channel has become an essential component of everyone’s
CSE journey. The idea is simple, community members send their individual interview
transcript to the admins, which are then posted on our channel. This was started when
transcripts were sold on various channels and ORN market and due to community efforts
only this stands demonetised today.
This pdf is just the plain compilation of all the Interview Transcripts of the session 2023
which were posted on our channel. This compilation is not that organized due to paucity of
time.

Lastly this was possible only because community (the members who appeared for interview
sent us their transcripts) came forward and hence this is dedicated to the entire CSE family.
I humbly request to those who will benefit from this pdf and are going to appear for CSPT2024, please send us your transcripts on the admin handles mentioned in the description of
our telegram channel (PTT 2023).
Best Wishes,
Team PTT

This compilation is created by PPT Team

same time, be prepared for random questions.

I am not sure Sir but I think in 1969 and 1981.

Because He makes the areas water surplus from water scarce or water deficit.

Situation Where we recharge more water than what we extract. For example - 100 litres a

With help of traditional water harvesting systems for recharge and with help of panchayat he

I told 'Johad' in my area and he was quite satisfied by it and Pond,pokhar,lake,tanka etc.

me ample time to think, and the ambiance of the room was very light.

Mock Interview - I took multiple mocks - OnlyIAS, Samkalp, Vajirao, NextIAS. More or less,
every coaching mock is the same. They prepare you to handle stressful situations and
present yourself in a better way.

One-to-One - S N Patil Sir (DM, my home district) and Rahul Sir (IAS PCS Pathshala).

interview were on same lines to those Rahul Sir and I had discussed from my DAF. That was
very helpful.

prepare your DAF very well, as many counter questions can be asked. All the best
